benefits_health_001.answer: yes; TRS-ActiveCare; active contributing TRS members and non-contributing TRS members working at least 10 hours per week
benefits_health_001.evidence: Group health insurance coverage is provided through TRS-ActiveCare, the statewide public school health insurance program. Employees eligible for health insurance coverage include the following: Employees who are active, contributing TRS members; Employees who are not contributing TRS members and who are regularly scheduled to work at least 10 hours per week

benefits_dental_006.answer: yes; available through Cafeteria Plan (Section 125) and supplemental insurance programs
benefits_dental_006.evidence: Cafeteria Plan (Section 125) ... enables eligible employees to pay certain insurance premiums on a pretax basis (i.e., disability, accidental death and dismemberment, cancer and dread disease, dental and additional term life insurance). At their own expense, employees may enroll in certain supplemental insurance programs.
